blocks.text: So'z tartibi: fe'l + to'ldiruvchi, keyin joy va vaqt

Asosiy qoida qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 93-dars): ega + **fe'l + to'ldiruvchi**, ular orasiga hech narsa kirmaydi; joy vaqtdan oldin keladi; vaqt gap boshiga chiqishi mumkin. O'zbek tilida esa fe'l oxirida turadi, «qanday?», «qachon?», «qayerda?» so'zlari undan **oldin** keladi: «Dilnoza kecha ofisda hisobotni diqqat bilan yozdi». Bu tartibni inglizchaga ko'chirsak, so'zlar fe'l bilan to'ldiruvchi orasiga tushib qoladi. Bu darsda — chuqurroq: tarz ravishining ikki o'rni, uzun to'ldiruvchi va **explain to me** turidagi fe'llar, to'ldiruvchidan keyingi to'liq tartib (qanday → qayerda → qachon), harakat fe'llari va gap boshidagi vaqt va joy.

rows: Aziz runs **in the park every morning**.
Dilnoza **wrote the report** carefully at the office yesterday.
**Explain to me** what this word means.

blocks.text: Fe'l + to'ldiruvchi: o'rtaga hech narsa kirmaydi

To'ldiruvchi bitta so'z (it, tea), uzun ot birikmasi (the report about last year's sales) yoki butun gap bo'lishi mumkin — baribir u fe'lning yonida turadi. «juda», «yaxshi», «ravon», «diqqat bilan», «yana», «har kuni», «kecha» to'ldiruvchidan keyin keladi. O'zbekchadagi «juda yaxshi ko'raman» ni ko'chirib «I very like» yoki «I like very much tea» deyish — eng ko'p uchraydigan xato. Kuchaytirish kerak bo'lsa, ikki yo'l bor: to'ldiruvchidan keyin **very much** (I **like tea** very much) yoki fe'ldan oldin **really** (I **really like** tea) — fe'l oldidagi ravishlar haqida 110-darsda.

rows: I **really like** this song. / I **like this song** very much.
We visited last month our grandparents.
He **opened the door** slowly. / He slowly **opened the door**.

items.text: I **really like** your new haircut — it suits you.
items.translation: Yangi soch turmagingiz menga **juda yoqdi** — sizga yarashibdi.

items.text: Jasur **speaks English** well, but he **writes it** badly.
items.translation: Jasur ingliz tilida yaxshi **gapiradi**, lekin yomon **yozadi**.

items.text: We **visited our grandparents** in Khiva last month.

blocks.text: Tarz ravishi: oxirida yoki fe'ldan oldin

«Qanday?» savoliga javob beradigan `-ly` ravishlar (carefully, slowly, quietly, suddenly, gently) ikki joyda tura oladi: to'ldiruvchidan keyin — He closed the door **quietly**, yoki asosiy fe'ldan oldin — He **quietly** closed the door. Ikkinchisi yozma hikoyada ko'proq uchraydi. Uchinchi joy — fe'l va to'ldiruvchi orasi — yo'q. Majhul nisbatda ravish yordamchi fe'l va V3 orasida turadi: The house was **carefully** restored. Lekin **well**, **badly**, **hard**, **fast** faqat oxirida: He plays the piano **well** («He well plays» emas).

items.text: Tom **slowly** opened the letter from the university.
He plays the guitar **well**, but he can't sing at all.
items.translation: U gitarani **yaxshi** chaladi, lekin umuman qo'shiq ayta olmaydi.

blocks.text: Uzun to'ldiruvchi va explain to me

**explain**, **describe**, **suggest**, **say**, **mention**, **introduce** fe'llari kishini **to** orqali oladi: explain something **to** somebody. O'zbekchada «**menga** tushuntiring» — jo'nalish kelishigi, lekin inglizchada «explain me» deyilmaydi. Qaysi biri oldin keladi? To'ldiruvchi qisqa bo'lsa — u fe'l yonida, kishi oxirida: **explain it to me**. To'ldiruvchi uzun (ayniqsa butun gap) bo'lsa — u oxirga suriladi: **explain to me** how it works. Taqqoslang: **tell**, **show**, **give**, **ask** kishini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri oladi: **tell me**, **show me** (→ qizil kitob, 96-dars).

rows: describe **to the police** what the man looked like
mention **to your boss** that you're leaving

items.text: Can you **explain it to me** once more? I missed the start.
items.translation: Buni **menga** yana bir marta **tushuntira olasizmi**? Boshini eshitmay qoldim.

items.text: She **explained to us** what had happened at the airport.
Could you **describe to me** what your bag looks like?
items.translation: Sumkangiz qanday ko'rinishini **menga tasvirlab bera olasizmi**?

blocks.text: To'ldiruvchidan keyin bir nechta qism kelsa, odatiy tartib: **qanday?** (tarz) → **qayerda / qayerga?** (joy) → **qachon?** (vaqt): She sang **beautifully at the concert last night**. «Qancha vaqt?» va «necha marta?» ham odatda joydan keyin keladi: I studied **in the library for four hours**; We go **to the pool twice a week**. **go, come, arrive, get, move** kabi harakat fe'llaridan keyin joy fe'lga eng yaqin turadi: We got **home late** («late home» emas). Ikki vaqt ifodasi bo'lsa, ko'pincha kichigi oldin: at nine **tomorrow morning** — o'zbekchada teskari: «ertaga ertalab soat to'qqizda».

items.text: My uncle has worked **in Russia for six years**.
Let's meet **at the café at four tomorrow**.
She arrived **home late** after the party, so she overslept.
items.translation: U ziyofatdan keyin **uyga kech** keldi, shuning uchun uxlab qoldi.

blocks.text: Vaqt ifodasi gap boshiga chiqishi mumkin — vaziyatni tasvirlash, taqqoslash yoki urg'u uchun: **Last spring** we moved to Tashkent; **In the evening** the streets are quieter. Hikoya va yangiliklarda joy ham boshga chiqadi: **In Samarkand**, the festival lasted three days. Uzun ifodadan keyin vergul qo'yiladi. Lekin bu so'zlar fe'l va to'ldiruvchi orasiga ham, ega va fe'l orasiga ham kirmaydi: «I every day go to work» — xato. **every day** — always / usually kabi gap o'rtasidagi ravish emas (→ 110-dars), u gap oxirida yoki boshida turadi.

items.text: **Last spring** we planted ten apple trees in the garden.
items.translation: **O'tgan bahor** bog'ga o'nta olma daraxti ekdik.

items.text: **In Khiva**, the old town is surrounded by high walls.
items.translation: **Xivada** eski shahar baland devorlar bilan o'ralgan.

items.text: **After lunch** I usually go for a short walk.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I very like tea» → I **really like** tea / I **like tea** very much; «She speaks very well English» → She **speaks English** very well; «I every day go to work» → I go to work **every day** / **Every day** I go to work; «Explain me this rule» → **Explain this rule to me**; «He described me the situation» → He **described the situation to me**; «I met yesterday Aziz» → I **met Aziz** yesterday; «We arrived late home» → We arrived **home late**; «Tomorrow I at nine will come» → I'll come **at nine tomorrow**.

Formula: **Kim? → nima qiladi? → nimani? → qanday? → qayerda? → qachon?** Fe'l va to'ldiruvchini «ajralmas juftlik» deb tasavvur qiling: ular o'rtasiga hech narsa sig'maydi. O'zbekcha gapni tarjima qilganda avval fe'lni toping va uni egadan keyinga qo'ying, qolgan qismlarni esa o'zbekcha tartibga **teskari** joylashtiring.

Bog'lanish: always, also, probably, all, both kabi gap o'rtasidagi ravishlar — 110-dars; still, yet, already — 111-dars; even — 112-dars; give me the book / give it to me — qizil kitob, 96-dars; tarz ravishlari (quickly, well, hard) — 100–101-darslar.

rows: tarz ravishi: oxirida yoki fe'ldan oldin
He closed the door **quietly**. / He **quietly** closed the door.
**Explain to me** how it works. / **Explain it to me**.
She sang **beautifully at the concert last night**.
I studied **in the library for four hours**.

examples.title: Verb + object together: **speaks three languages**
examples.description: Fe'l va to'ldiruvchi yonma-yon; very much, well, fluently, again, every day — to'ldiruvchidan keyin.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **speaks three languages** fluently, so the company often sends her abroad.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **uch tilda** ravon **gapiradi**, shuning uchun kompaniya uni tez-tez xorijga yuboradi.

sentences.text: I **enjoy my job** very much, but the salary could be better.
sentences.translation: **Ishimni** juda **yaxshi ko'raman**, lekin maosh yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin edi.

sentences.text: Please **check the figures** again before you send the report.
sentences.translation: Hisobotni yuborishdan oldin **raqamlarni** yana bir bor **tekshiring**.

sentences.text: Our neighbour **plays the violin** beautifully, but only late at night.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnimiz **skripkani** ajoyib **chaladi**, lekin faqat kechasi.

sentences.text: Did you **lock the front door** properly when you left?
sentences.translation: Chiqayotganda **old eshikni** yaxshilab **qulfladingizmi**?

sentences.text: Bekzod **reads the news** on his phone every morning.
sentences.translation: Bekzod har kuni ertalab telefonida **yangiliklarni o'qiydi**.

sentences.text: We **loved the hotel** in Bukhara, especially the breakfast.
sentences.translation: Buxorodagi **mehmonxona** bizga juda **yoqdi**, ayniqsa nonushtasi.

sentences.text: Kate **answered all the questions** confidently at the interview.
sentences.translation: Keyt suhbatda **barcha savollarga** ishonch bilan **javob berdi**.

sentences.text: In this heat you should **drink plenty of water** throughout the day.
sentences.translation: Bunday jaziramada kun davomida **ko'p suv ichishingiz** kerak.

sentences.text: The new manager **explained the plan** very clearly at the first meeting.
sentences.translation: Yangi rahbar birinchi yig'ilishda **rejani** juda aniq **tushuntirdi**.

examples.title: Manner adverbs: **quietly closed** / read it **carefully**
examples.description: Tarz ravishi to'ldiruvchidan keyin yoki asosiy fe'ldan oldin turadi; **well**, **hard** — faqat oxirida; majhul nisbatda — V3 oldida.

sentences.text: James **quietly closed** the door so he wouldn't wake the baby.
sentences.translation: Jeyms chaqaloqni uyg'otmaslik uchun eshikni **sekingina yopdi**.

sentences.text: Madina read the contract **carefully** before she signed it.
sentences.translation: Madina shartnomani imzolashdan oldin uni **diqqat bilan** o'qib chiqdi.

sentences.text: The firefighters **quickly put out** the fire in the kitchen.
sentences.translation: O't o'chiruvchilar oshxonadagi yong'inni **tezda o'chirishdi**.

sentences.text: Jasur plays chess **well**, but he loses when he's tired.
sentences.translation: Jasur shaxmatni **yaxshi** o'ynaydi, lekin charchaganida yutqazadi.

sentences.text: She **suddenly remembered** that she had left her passport at home.
sentences.translation: U pasportini uyda qoldirgani **birdan esiga tushdi**.

sentences.text: Oliver was angry, but he answered the customer's email **politely**.
sentences.translation: Oliverning jahli chiqqan edi, lekin mijozning xatiga **xushmuomalalik bilan** javob berdi.

sentences.text: The old palace was **beautifully restored** by local craftsmen.
sentences.translation: Qadimiy saroy mahalliy ustalar tomonidan **chiroyli qilib ta'mirlangan**.

sentences.text: Please write your name **clearly** in capital letters.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, ismingizni bosh harflar bilan **aniq** yozing.

sentences.text: Sarah **gently woke** her son and told him the good news.
sentences.translation: Sara o'g'lini **ohista uyg'otdi** va unga xushxabarni aytdi.

sentences.text: My grandmother speaks Russian **perfectly**, but she rarely uses it now.
sentences.translation: Buvim rus tilida **mukammal** gapiradi, lekin hozir uni kamdan-kam ishlatadi.

examples.title: **explain to me**, **describe to the police**
examples.description: explain / describe / mention / introduce + **to** + kishi; uzun to'ldiruvchi (gap) oxirga suriladi. tell / show — to siz.

sentences.text: Could you **explain to me** how this machine works?
sentences.translation: Bu mashina qanday ishlashini **menga tushuntirib bera olasizmi**?

sentences.text: The witness **described to the police** exactly what she had seen.
sentences.translation: Guvoh ko'rganlarini aniq-tiniq **politsiyaga tasvirlab berdi**.

sentences.text: Can you **explain this rule to me** again? I didn't understand it.
sentences.translation: Bu qoidani **menga** yana bir bor **tushuntira olasizmi**? Tushunmadim.

sentences.text: Our guide **recommended a small restaurant** near the Registan.
sentences.translation: Gidimiz Registon yaqinidagi **kichik restoranni tavsiya qildi**.

sentences.text: I **explained to my boss** why the project was late.
sentences.translation: Loyiha nega kechikkanini **boshlig'imga tushuntirdim**.

sentences.text: Jasur **introduced me to** his parents at the wedding.
sentences.translation: Jasur to'yda **meni ota-onasi bilan tanishtirdi**.

sentences.text: Nobody **mentioned to us** that the museum was closed on Mondays.
sentences.translation: Muzey dushanba kunlari yopiqligini hech kim **bizga aytmadi**.

sentences.text: Will you **show me** how to change my password on this app?
sentences.translation: Bu ilovada parolni qanday o'zgartirishni **menga ko'rsatib berasizmi**?

sentences.text: Please **describe to the doctor** where exactly you feel the pain.
sentences.translation: Og'riq aynan qayerda sezilishini **shifokorga tasvirlab bering**.

sentences.text: Emma **said to me** that she wasn't happy, but she didn't **tell me** why.
sentences.translation: Emma **menga** baxtli emasligini **aytdi**, lekin nega ekanini **aytmadi**.

examples.title: Place before time: **at the gym three times a week**
examples.description: To'ldiruvchidan keyin avval joy, keyin vaqt, qancha vaqt yoki necha marta. O'zbekchada tartib ko'pincha teskari.

sentences.text: Sarah works out **at the gym three times a week**.
sentences.translation: Sara **haftasiga uch marta sport zalida** mashq qiladi.

sentences.text: We arrived **at the hotel late at night**, so the restaurant was closed.
sentences.translation: **Mehmonxonaga kechasi kech** yetib keldik, shuning uchun restoran yopiq edi.

sentences.text: My parents moved **to Tashkent in 1998**, before I was born.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam **1998-yilda Toshkentga** ko'chib kelishgan, men tug'ilmasimdan oldin.

sentences.text: Bekzod has been working **at the bank since March**.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **martdan beri bankda** ishlayapti.

sentences.text: I'll meet you **outside the cinema at half past seven**.
sentences.translation: Siz bilan **soat yettiyu o'ttizda kinoteatr oldida** uchrashaman.

sentences.text: The conference will take place **in Edinburgh next spring**.
sentences.translation: Konferensiya **kelasi bahorda Edinburgda** bo'lib o'tadi.

sentences.text: Did you leave your keys **in the car again this morning**?
sentences.translation: **Bugun ertalab yana** kalitlaringizni **mashinada** qoldirdingizmi?

sentences.text: Nilufar studied **in the library for five hours** yesterday.
sentences.translation: Nilufar kecha **kutubxonada besh soat** o'qidi.

sentences.text: Thousands of people gathered **in the main square on New Year's Eve**.
sentences.translation: **Yangi yil kechasi bosh maydonda** minglab odamlar yig'ildi.

sentences.text: Are you going **to Samarkand by train on Friday**, or flying?
sentences.translation: **Juma kuni Samarqandga poyezdda** ketyapsizmi yoki samolyotda?

examples.title: How → where → when: **happily in the garden all afternoon**
examples.description: To'liq tartib: tarz (qanday?) → joy (qayerda?) → vaqt (qachon? qancha?). O'zbekcha tarjimada bu qismlar fe'ldan oldin keladi.

sentences.text: Nilufar sang **beautifully at her sister's wedding last Saturday**.
sentences.translation: Nilufar **o'tgan shanba opasining to'yida chiroyli** qo'shiq aytdi.

sentences.text: The children played **happily in the garden all afternoon**.
sentences.translation: Bolalar **tushdan keyin bog'da xursand** o'ynashdi.

sentences.text: Jasur worked **hard at university for four years**, and it paid off.
sentences.translation: Jasur **to'rt yil universitetda astoydil** o'qidi va bu o'z samarasini berdi.

sentences.text: We waited **patiently at the border for three hours**.
sentences.translation: Biz **chegarada uch soat sabr bilan** kutdik.

sentences.text: The students listened **carefully in the lecture hall for two hours**.
sentences.translation: Talabalar **ikki soat ma'ruza zalida diqqat bilan** tinglashdi.

sentences.text: The baby slept **peacefully in the car all the way to Fergana**.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq **Farg'onagacha butun yo'l mashinada tinchgina** uxladi.

sentences.text: Grandpa walks **slowly round the park every evening**.
sentences.translation: Bobom **har kuni kechqurun bog' atrofida sekin** sayr qiladi.

sentences.text: Did the team play **well in the final on Sunday**?
sentences.translation: Jamoa **yakshanba kuni finalda yaxshi** o'ynadimi?

sentences.text: My brother has lived **happily in Manchester for ten years**.
sentences.translation: Akam **o'n yildan beri Manchesterda baxtli** yashaydi.

sentences.text: Oliver spoke **confidently at the conference in London last month**.
sentences.translation: Oliver **o'tgan oy Londondagi konferensiyada ishonch bilan** nutq so'zladi.

examples.title: Time and place at the start: **Two years ago**, ...
examples.description: Vaqt yoki joy gap boshida — vaziyatni tasvirlash va urg'u uchun. Fe'l + to'ldiruvchi baribir yonma-yon qoladi.

sentences.text: **Two years ago**, Madina started her own online business.
sentences.translation: **Ikki yil oldin** Madina o'zining onlayn biznesini boshladi.

sentences.text: **Every Friday**, the whole family gets together for plov.
sentences.translation: **Har juma** butun oila palov uchun yig'iladi.

sentences.text: **In the evening**, the old town of Bukhara looks magical.
sentences.translation: **Kechqurun** Buxoroning eski shahri sehrli ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: **After the meeting**, James sent everyone a summary by email.
sentences.translation: **Yig'ilishdan keyin** Jeyms hammaga elektron pochta orqali qisqacha xulosa yubordi.

sentences.text: **Last night** there was a power cut in our part of the city.
sentences.translation: **Kecha kechqurun** shaharning biz yashaydigan qismida elektr o'chdi.

sentences.text: **In London**, most people travel to work by underground.
sentences.translation: **Londonda** ko'pchilik ishga metroda boradi.

sentences.text: **On Sundays** I don't check my work emails at all.
sentences.translation: **Yakshanba kunlari** ish xatlarimni umuman tekshirmayman.

sentences.text: **At the end of the course**, every student has to give a presentation.
sentences.translation: **Kurs oxirida** har bir talaba taqdimot qilishi kerak.

sentences.text: **Since the pandemic**, many British companies have allowed staff to work from home twice a week.
sentences.translation: **Pandemiyadan beri** ko'plab Britaniya kompaniyalari xodimlariga haftasiga ikki kun uydan ishlashga ruxsat berib kelmoqda.

sentences.text: **This time next year**, Jasur will be studying in Oxford.
sentences.translation: **Kelasi yil shu paytda** Jasur Oksfordda o'qiyotgan bo'ladi.

examples.title: Questions and negatives: did you **see Aziz** there?
examples.description: So'roq va inkor gaplarda ham fe'l + to'ldiruvchi yonma-yon, keyin joy va vaqt.

sentences.text: Did you **see Aziz** at the conference yesterday?
sentences.translation: Kecha konferensiyada **Azizni ko'rdingizmi**?

sentences.text: I didn't **watch the match** on TV last night — I was too tired.
sentences.translation: Kecha televizorda **o'yinni ko'rmadim** — juda charchagan edim.

sentences.text: Where did you **buy that jacket**? It looks great on you.
sentences.translation: O'sha **kurtkani** qayerdan **sotib oldingiz**? Sizga juda yarashibdi.

sentences.text: Have you **paid the electricity bill** this month?
sentences.translation: Bu oy **elektr uchun to'ladingizmi**?

sentences.text: Why doesn't Bekzod **answer his phone** in the evenings?
sentences.translation: Nega Bekzod kechqurunlari **telefonini ko'tarmaydi**?

sentences.text: We don't **eat meat** on Mondays — it's a family tradition.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kunlari **go'sht yemaymiz** — bu oilaviy an'ana.

sentences.text: How often do you **visit your grandparents** in Fergana?
sentences.translation: Farg'onadagi **bobo-buvingizni** qanchalik tez-tez **yo'qlaysiz**?

sentences.text: Sarah didn't **understand the instructions** at first, so she called the support line.
sentences.translation: Sara avvaliga **ko'rsatmalarni tushunmadi**, shuning uchun yordam xizmatiga qo'ng'iroq qildi.

sentences.text: Who **left the window** open in the office all night?
sentences.translation: Kim ofisda **derazani** tun bo'yi ochiq **qoldirdi**?

sentences.text: Will you **send me the documents** by email before Friday?
sentences.translation: Hujjatlarni jumagacha elektron pochta orqali **menga yuborasizmi**?

examples.title: Mixed: news and work
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: yangiliklar va ish mavzusida uzun gaplar — fe'l + to'ldiruvchi + tarz + joy + vaqt.

sentences.text: The government **opened a new hospital** in Namangan last week.
sentences.translation: Hukumat o'tgan hafta Namanganda **yangi shifoxona ochdi**.

sentences.text: According to the report, prices **rose sharply** in the capital last year.
sentences.translation: Hisobotga ko'ra, o'tgan yili poytaxtda narxlar **keskin oshdi**.

sentences.text: Our company **launched its new app** successfully in five countries this spring.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyamiz bu bahor besh mamlakatda **yangi ilovasini** muvaffaqiyatli **ishga tushirdi**.

sentences.text: Police **questioned two men** at the airport on Tuesday night.
sentences.translation: Politsiya seshanba kuni kechasi aeroportda **ikki kishini so'roq qildi**.

sentences.text: Every summer, thousands of tourists **visit the ancient city** of Khiva.
sentences.translation: Har yozda minglab sayyohlar **qadimiy Xiva shahriga tashrif buyuradi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **explained to the investors** how the product would make money.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza mahsulot qanday daromad keltirishini **investorlarga tushuntirdi**.

sentences.text: The minister **answered the journalists' questions** briefly after the meeting.
sentences.translation: Vazir yig'ilishdan keyin **jurnalistlarning savollariga** qisqacha **javob berdi**.

sentences.text: Scientists **have studied the problem** carefully for many years.
sentences.translation: Olimlar ko'p yillar davomida **muammoni** sinchiklab **o'rganishgan**.

sentences.text: In March, the city council **will close the main bridge** for repairs.
sentences.translation: Mart oyida shahar kengashi ta'mirlash uchun **asosiy ko'prikni yopadi**.

sentences.text: Emma **writes her articles** quietly at home in the mornings, when the children are at school.
sentences.translation: Emma ertalablari, bolalar maktabda bo'lganida, uyda tinchgina **maqolalarini yozadi**.
